title: Rational surface singularities acquire Gorenstein models by point blowups
statement: Let $(C,\mathfrak n)$ be a commutative Noetherian complete local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $R$ be a normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$, essentially of finite type over $C$, meaning a localization of a finitely generated $C$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Suppose $R$ defines a rational singularity [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Then there is a finite sequence $X_n\to\cdots\to X_0=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of ordinary blowups at singular closed points above the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Every $X_i$ is integral and normal. Every local ring of $X_n$ is Gorenstein, meaning it has finite injective dimension as a module over itself. The composite is proper and induces an isomorphism of function fields [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-sc-function-field]. Length zero is allowed.

source.place: Tag 0BBV, resolve-lemma-rational-to-gorenstein, specialized using dualizing.tex Tag 0BFR (dualizing-lemma-ubiquity-dualizing), clauses (2),(5). Normal surfaces are Cohen-Macaulay by properties.tex Tag 0B3D, and an invertible dualizing sheaf gives Gorenstein local rings by duality.tex Tag 0AWW (duality-definition-gorenstein).
